comms.b: REBIRTH WORKED STOP ERSKINE DEAD STOP FORMULA GONE WITH HIM STOP ONE SUPER SOLDIER IS ALL WE GET STOP PHILLIPS
Bruce Banner has been located in Rio de Janeiro. Emil Blonsky goes in with the team. Bring Banner in alive. Do not let him get angry.

comms.t: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
comms.b: Stopped for gas on the way to New Mexico and walked into an armed robbery. Two suspects, both down. I'm back on the road. No need to put this in the report.
The Council wants Emil Blonsky on the Avengers Initiative. We don't. So we're sending General Ross a consultant to ask for him: Tony Stark. If anyone can make a meeting go badly, it's Stark.
The Chitauri gun is back in our hands. The couple who robbed banks with it are now on the payroll. He's in R&D, she's my new assistant. Anyone who can make that thing work is worth hiring.
Jane is back, Thor is back, and Erik ran naked around Stonehenge, so we had to spring him from a psych ward. Also there's a spaceship in Greenwich now. I have an intern. His name is Ian.
Groot's out of his pot again. Whoever's on twig duty, you had one job. If he looks at you and says "I am Groot," he's about to do something. Watch him.
Every suit I built went up like fireworks last night, and I did it for Pepper. The shrapnel's out of my chest too, so no more arc reactor. I'm still Iron Man. That part doesn't come out.
The actor who played the Mandarin is in Seagate Prison, enjoying his fame. The real Mandarin wants him. Gain his trust, then bring him out.
Somebody broke into the facility today. He was very small, he beat me, and he got away. Don't tell Cap. Actually, I'm telling Cap: I know a guy now.
Wakanda has bought a block of buildings in Oakland, California, for its first international outreach center. Princess Shuri will lead the science and information exchange. Everyone is welcome.

Effective immediately, cleanup of alien material from the Battle of New York is a federal operation, run jointly with Stark Industries. Private contractors are released from their contracts. Leave all recovered material on site.

comms.f: Doctor Stephen Strange, New York Sanctum
comms.b: I have added Loki of Asgard to our list of beings who threaten Earth. His brother Thor came asking for help finding their father, Odin. I sent them both to Norway. One fewer god in New York.
Asgard is destroyed. This ship carries its survivors under King Thor, and we are setting course for Earth. Asgard is not a place. It's a people.
Fury's pager went dark. Minutes later, a woman we've never seen walked into the compound. She is asking where Fury is. Rogers, Romanoff, Banner and Rhodes are with her now.

Scott Lang is days away from finishing his house arrest. Every time we check, he's home. I'd still like to know who was out in the bay this week. And why there is an ant playing the drums in his house.
I'm sorry about your sister. When you're ready, I can give you the name of the man responsible for her death. Clint Barton.
Westview is free. Director Hayward is in FBI custody for what he tried to do with Vision. Wanda is gone. The town remembers everything she made them do, and so do I.
That wasn't me in Europe. Talos and Soren wore our faces while I was away on other business. Mysterio fooled them anyway. Next time, I'm going myself.
Spider-Man stopped by to let us know he's leaving town on a trip. He asked us to keep an eye on the neighborhood while he's gone. We said we'd manage.
Seen Peter Parker? TheDailyBugle.net wants your photos, videos and sightings of the web-slinging menace. J. Jonah Jameson reads every tip personally, and he would like that noted.

A spell has been cast over the whole world. Everyone on Earth has forgotten someone, and none of us can say who. The visitors from other universes have been sent home. If your files hold a name you cannot place, leave it alone.
Clint made it home to his family for Christmas. I kept the dog. Hawkeye is still a work in progress, but so is everything.

comms.t: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
comms.b: Kamar-Taj is rebuilding, and we have buried our dead. A new student has joined us. Her name is America Chavez, and she travels between universes. Be kind to her.

comms.t: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
comms.b: The Ten Rings are older than anything we know, and they are sending a signal to someone we cannot name. Their new bearer, Shang-Chi, is welcome here. So is his friend Katy. The karaoke was a one-time thing.
My husband, Ulysses Bloodstone, is dead. You are summoned to Bloodstone Manor to honor him, and to hunt. Whoever kills the beast will wield the Bloodstone.

Quill went home to Earth to see his grandpa. Gamora's back with the Ravagers, Drax and Nebula are staying on Knowhere, Mantis went to find herself, and I'm captain now. New roster: me, Groot, Kraglin, Cosmo, Adam and the kid Phyla. Apply in person.
Vibranium has left Wakanda before, and every piece of it must come home. Find it, wherever it went and whoever holds it. No one outside our borders may learn what you carry back.
Since the Annihilator destroyed the Supreme Intelligence, Hala has lost its air, its water and its sun. I hold one Quantum Band. The other is on C-53. Find it and bring it to me.
Captain Rambeau didn't make it back before the jump point closed. Carol is looking for her. Meanwhile, Kamala Khan is putting together a team of her own. God help us all.
I'm looking for my brother, Tommy. He came back the same way I did, in someone else's life. If your files ever turn up a kid who runs too fast, tell me.
President Ross says the world needs the Avengers again. I think he's right, and I'm putting them back together. I'll need people I can trust. Consider this your call.
Variant of interest: Victor Timely, inventor, 1901. Agents are observing his public demonstration. Do not engage. Do not tell him what he could become.
Registrant Elena Rodriguez, Inhuman. Ability: super-speed. Registration processed under the Sokovia Accords. Registrants may not use their abilities without approval.
In this reality, a plague from the Quantum Realm turned Earth's heroes into the hungry dead. A handful of young survivors fight on, Kamala Khan among them. I am sworn only to watch.

comms.t: Team Thor, Team Thor: Part 2 & Team Darryl
comms.b: Thor moved out. My new roommate is called the Grandmaster, and he is a lot. If anyone at S.H.I.E.L.D. is looking for him, he's on my couch.
A new breed called the Reapers feeds on vampires and humans alike. Our Bloodpack trained to hunt you. Now we ask you to lead them against the Reapers.
The Treasure is a girl named Abby Miller. The assassin Elektra Natchios protects her now. Bring us the girl. Kill the assassin.
Our friend Alex is trapped in the Dark Dimension, and I hear you two know your way around the dark. We need a ride. We'll owe you.
New mutant signature detected at a shopping mall. A teenage girl. She makes fireworks with her hands. Her foster parents have called the Mutant Control Agency.
